case_classification.short_description: Loan Amortization Schedule for an Annuity Loan - trap leap year day (02/29) is the starting date for the model

ai_time_estimate_reasoning: This task requires building a dynamic loan amortization schedule with mismatching payment and compounding frequencies (monthly payments vs. quarterly compounding). An expert modeler will need to calculate the correct periodic interest rate using the formula (1 + nominal_rate / compounding_frequency)^(compounding_frequency / payment_frequency) - 1, build out the 180-month schedule with accurate date-shifting logic (e.g., EDATE), and then use lookup and aggregation formulas (like VLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH and SUMIFS) to dynamically populate the 25 specific questions on the Questions tab.
